title: Living Scaffold
transformation: Original garden layouts, SVG art and articulated-body transition implementation. Retains food growth, gravity, bodies as support, and all-creatures exits. No source code, levels or assets copied. No pushing, boxes, spikes or teleportation. Each creature has its own matching blossom; all blossoms open after all food.
assets: Original inline SVG and CSS; no third-party assets.
source_limitations: Source publisher timed out during this run; stored survey and linked repository documentation were read. No commercial game play or human calibration performed.
